latestVersion.changelog:
guardian-auto-healer 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Provides a 24/7 watchdog and auto-healer for OpenClaw gateways.
- Monitors gateway health, memory usage, zombie sessions, and disk space every 5 minutes.
- Automatically restarts the gateway when unresponsive or over memory thresholds.
- Logs all health checks and actions with timestamps to a dedicated log file.
- Simple setup using cron job; includes troubleshooting and manual run guidance.
